title: Acceleration without friction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a₁ = g sinθ = 5 m/s².

title: Acceleration with friction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a₂ = g sinθ - μ g cosθ = 2.5 m/s².

title: Time to bottom
description: Essential: Correctly calculates t = √(2s/a₁) ≈ 1.41 s or √2 s.

title: Speed at bottom
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v = a₁ t ≈ 7.07 m/s or 5√2 m/s.

title: Free-body diagram reasoning
description: Important: Identifies forces (gravity, normal, friction) and resolves components along the incline.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: Applies F_net = ma correctly for both frictionless and frictional cases.

title: Kinematic equation selection
description: Important: Uses s = ½ a t² (from rest) to find time and v = at to find final speed.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Uses friction force with wrong sign (adding instead of subtracting for downhill motion).

title: Trigonometric error
description: Pitfall: Confuses sinθ and cosθ when resolving weight or friction force.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout calculations.
